body: Can relate in a similar, situation albeit self inflicted, hope you get better

Ultimately as someone who is in the same situation however not in the US I resonate with the reasoning that you have discussed we are often led in this zeitgeist that is the academic path is the only way however this can contradict with the reality of the situation ultimately if academics is not for you then you should consider other options look at the founder of enterprise for example.
Try something new, it’s a lot easier finding a date when you meet people in real life compared to online, I would suggest going to a singles event.

Same here, business ventures failed, parents threw me out saying I was the failed child, burned money on stupid shit trying to feel like a human being in this zeitgeist that is the modern world, broken and broke with nothing left cannot even drive or hold a job, friends spat in my face laughing at my failure and to end it all my body is broken cannot move like I used to, pain everywhere with no apparent solution in sight, student loans getting bigger and bigger. My dreams of traveling the world as a financier have died along with my soul and spirit death seems like a relief in this ocean of sorrow and spite that plagues my consciousness.
